name: Intelligence desk
question: Who expects what from AI, and who has changed their mind?
summary: The map of views in Futuras places what 25 named people and groups have said about AI on ten questions (timelines, risk, handing control to AI, pace, power, China), with a quoted passage behind every placement. Statements go stale fast. Each mission is one person: find what they have said since the latest statement on record and code it the same way.
why: Policy and strategy arguments about AI lean on what influential people believe. A current, sourced record of those beliefs, including when they shift, is shared situational awareness. This is not research: it is keeping the picture accurate.
judge: Quotes and structure are checked by machine (every passage must be on its page); the placements are reviewed by a person before anything is credited or merged.
